summary: Build advanced ESG portfolio skills in five days with practical tools for integration, carbon analysis, stewardship, risk, and reporting. Enrol today.
lede: ESG portfolio management training helps portfolio managers, ESG analysts, stewardship officers, and investment risk specialists connect sustainability evidence to investment decisions. Participants practise materiality analysis, financed-emissions measurement, portfolio construction and risk testing, then use findings to shape issuer engagement and evidence-based reporting, with attention to data limitations and human review of AI-assisted research.
audienceIntro: This course is for investment professionals who already work with portfolios, research, risk, stewardship, or sustainability data and now need a more rigorous ESG investment portfolio management process. The level suits professionals who can interpret investment research and portfolio information but want structured practice connecting ESG evidence to capital allocation and reporting decisions.
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of investment portfolios, financial analysis, or asset management processes. Familiarity with ESG terminology, sustainability disclosures, or responsible investment policies is useful but not mandatory. No programming is required. Exercises use structured datasets, spreadsheet templates, and guided dashboard examples rather than production system configuration. Advanced climate analytics and AI-assisted research are taught at operational application level, not technical engineering level.
